issue_context.title: Support unbinding bound text
issue_context.body:
Currently text is bound to a shape if clicked on center of shape or enter is pressed when clicked on shape.
We have been getting few feedbacks to add flexibility for unbinding text once bound to a shape so one way could be to unbind via context menu -> Right click on shape and unbind
